flags.issue: The big early jump falls flat. It only adds things around the right edge: the koi windsock, a strip of tiny red planters, a wood balcony and an arched glowing window, plus three bare orange cafe tables on the bridge. The middle of the frame barely changes. The bridge is still a grey concrete box with no deck, plants or pergola, the street is still a cold neon glitch pool, the stairs are unlit and the convenience store has no sign. The palette stays the same cold blue.
flags.fix: Make stage 1 change the center of the frame. Put warm wood planking and a planter-lined rail on the bridge, add warm orange step lights on the staircase, give the storefront its striped 'ほしマート' sign and swap the cold blue key light for an amber one. The cafe tables then sit on an actual terrace and are no longer floating on bare concrete.

flags.issue: Adds things that aren't in the end image: two tall black lamp/pergola poles standing in the street in front of the bridge, a large black slab blocking the lower-left foreground, and white zebra-crossing stripes across the road. None of these appear in the end image, and the poles and slab hide the street.
flags.fix: Remove the street poles, or turn them into the pergola frame sitting on the bridge deck. Replace the black foreground slab with the fern fronds from the end image. Drop the zebra crossing.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 1. Only the rain noise differs; I can't see any scene change from this angle.
flags.fix: Give it a visible step, e.g. lay the wood planking on the bridge deck or light the staircase.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 2. No visible change.
flags.fix: Add a readable element here, e.g. potted flowering shrubs on the bridge rail like the red pots in the end image.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 3. No visible change.
flags.fix: Add something visible, e.g. the shop sign and a warmer storefront, or paper lanterns on the bridge.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 4. Four stages in a row (2-5) have no visible progress, so the middle of the story is flat.
flags.fix: Spread the content: each of stages 2-5 needs at least one change you can read at thumbnail size from the high camera.

flags.issue: Adds two patio heaters on the bridge. They're the right idea, but they read as flat white-and-orange mushroom lamps with no glow, set behind the guard wall, so they barely register.
flags.fix: Make them tall, glowing amber heater columns like the end image, with emissive cores and a warm light spill onto the deck and tables.

flags.issue: The string lights are a thin row of dots hidden behind the far end of the bridge at the vanishing point. The change is too small to notice from this angle, and the end image hangs them overhead on a pergola canopy over the bridge.
flags.fix: Build the pergola frame over the bridge deck and drape the colored bulbs across it in the foreground half of the bridge, where they read as a lit canopy.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 7. No visible change.
flags.fix: Add a visible step, e.g. the pergola roof or glowing paper lanterns.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 8. No visible change.
flags.fix: Add a visible step, e.g. wisteria hanging off the bridge side facing the camera.

flags.issue: Looks the same as stage 9. Stages 8-10 are another dead stretch of three.
flags.fix: Use these stages for the warming of the street: amber reflections in place of the neon glitch noise, and a warm interior glow in the right-side windows.

flags.issue: Vines and purple wisteria appear in one burst, after ten stages with none, so it looks like several steps were skipped. They're also in the wrong place: the end image hangs the wisteria from the bridge planters, but here it's crammed onto the right building wall as crude, oversized purple polygon slabs. These sit right at the camera, cover the windows and the koi, and look like a mesh artifact.
flags.fix: Grow the greenery in steps from about stage 3 onward. Hang the wisteria from the bridge edge in thin, drooping racemes, and keep the right wall to a slim ivy column beside the door like the end image.

flags.issue: The final stage only grows the right-wall vines a little. That change is too small to notice, and the final frame still looks like the start image with props added. It's still a cold blue concrete bridge over a glitchy neon street, with no pergola canopy, no lanterns, no flowering pots on the rail, no warm wood walkway or windows, no shop sign and no warm palette. It ends far short of the end image.
flags.fix: The final stage needs to carry the full end-image look: wood deck and rail lined with red flowering pots, a pergola with string lights and lanterns, glowing heaters, wisteria draping off the bridge, the 'ほしマート' storefront, lit stair treads, warm reflections on wet ground and an overall shift to amber.

verdict: The sequence fails. The one big jump at stage 1 only decorates the right edge (koi, planters, balcony) and leaves the bridge, street and lighting, the subject of the shot, unchanged and cold. It also adds things that aren't in the end image: poles in the street, a black foreground slab and a zebra crossing. After that, 7 of the 11 later steps show no visible change (2-5 and 8-10). The changes that do happen (heaters, string lights at the vanishing point, and crude wisteria slabs on the wrong wall) are small or in the wrong place. The last frame reaches only about 40% of the end state, because the bridge never becomes a warm, planted terrace and the palette never shifts to amber.
